title: Quick Spanish Beans Fabada Asturiana
description: A rich and light Spanish dish from the Galician region, featuring sesame seed oil and nuka-pickle, this recipe is a quick-fix and gluten-free-friendly version of the traditional fabada asturiana.
instructions: Heat the sesame seed oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped nuka-pickle, canned butter beans, chicken broth, and tomato paste, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve the fabada asturiana hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
